reason: Positive Phase IIa proof-of-concept data for Rifaquizinone in treating prosthetic joint infections allows the company to progress to a multi-center Phase IIb trial, significantly de-risking the clinical pipeline.
why_now: The results and the initiation of the next trial phase were announced on September 7, 2026.
source_headlines: TENNOR THERAP-B (06872): VOLUNTARY ANNOUNCEMENT POSITIVE RESULTS FROM A PHASE IIA PROOF-OF-CONCEPT CLINICAL TRIAL OF RIFAQUIZINONE (TNP-2092) FOR THE TREATMENT OF PROSTHETIC JOINT INFECTION AND INITIATION OF A MULTI-CENTER PHASE IIB CLINICAL TRIAL
